### Patches (`ds_patches`)

-   Every row is a patch at a certain time point.

```{r}
ds_patches = import.protist.pop.data()
```

```{r}
ds_patches = ds_patches %>%
  filter(! culture_ID %in% patches_to_take_off)
```

```{r}

# Reorder

ds_patches = ds_patches %>%
  select(time_point,
         day,
         file,
         culture_ID,
         system_nr,
         eco_metaeco_type,
         trophic_type,
         patch_size,
         patch_size_ml,
         metaecosystem,
         metaecosystem_type,
         flow,
         flow_ml,
         bioarea_per_volume,
         all_of(protist_species_hetero),
         Ble_main_analysis,
         Cep_main_analysis,
         Spi_main_analysis)
```

```{r}
#Rearrange columns
ds_patches = ds_patches %>%
  select(time_point,
         day,
         file,
         culture_ID,
         system_nr,
         patch_type,
         trophic_type,
         patch_size,
         patch_size_ml,
         interaction_size_disturbance,
         metaecosystem,
         metaecosystem_type,
         bioarea_mm2_per_ml,
         all_of(protist_species_hetero_indiv_per_ml))
```

```{r}
#Calculate species dominance
ds_patches = ds_patches %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(protist_species_hetero_indiv_per_ml), 
                list(dominance = ~ (. / indiv_per_ml) * 100), 
                .names = "{col}_dominance"))
```

```{r}
#Calculate median body size
ds_median_body_size = ds_individuals %>%
  group_by(time_point,
           culture_ID,
           file) %>%
  summarise(median_body_area_µm2 = median(body_area_µm2)) %>%
  group_by(time_point,
           culture_ID) %>%
  summarise(median_body_area_µm2 = mean(median_body_area_µm2))

expect_true(nrow(ds_median_body_size) <= nrow(ds_patches))

ds_patches = full_join(ds_patches, ds_median_body_size)

expect_equal(nrow(ds_patches),
             n_rows_ds_patches_before_calculations)
```
